benefits.name: United Club membership
benefits.notes: United Club card membership for the primary cardmember (+1 adult guest and dependent children); upgrades to All Access (Star Alliance lounges, 2 guests) with Premier Gold or higher or $50,000 in calendar-year purchases.

benefits.name: Renowned Hotels credit
benefits.notes: Statement credit for prepaid Renowned Hotels and Resorts stays booked through United Hotels; resets each cardmember year.

benefits.name: Rideshare credit
benefits.notes: Up to $12/month in statement credits on rideshare purchases ($18 in December, $150/yr total); opt in every calendar year.

benefits.name: Instacart credit
benefits.notes: Two $10 Instacart credits each month in your Instacart account; Instacart+ membership included through 12/31/2027.

benefits.name: Avis / Budget credit
benefits.notes: Paid as United TravelBank cash: $50 on each of the first two Avis/Budget rentals booked via mileageplustravel.united.com per cardmember year.

benefits.name: JSX credit
benefits.notes: Statement credit on flights booked directly with JSX; resets each cardmember year.

benefits.name: Global Entry / TSA PreCheck
benefits.notes: Up to $120 statement credit for the Global Entry, TSA PreCheck or NEXUS application fee, once every 4 years.

benefits.name: Free checked bags
benefits.notes: First and second standard checked bags free for the primary cardmember and one companion on the same reservation (United/United Express-operated flights; ticket bought with the card, MileagePlus number on the reservation).

benefits.name: Premier Access
benefits.notes: Priority check-in, security, boarding and baggage handling (where available) for the primary cardmember and companions on the same reservation.

benefits.name: Spend award flight discount
benefits.notes: 10,000-mile award flight discount for each $20,000 in purchases in a calendar year, up to two (20,000 miles) per year; each expires 12 months after issue.

benefits.name: 1,500 Card Bonus PQP
benefits.notes: 1,500 Premier qualifying points posted within ~8 weeks of February 1 each year, starting the calendar year after account opening (account must be open on Dec 31 of the prior year).

benefits.name: IHG Platinum Elite status
benefits.notes: IHG One Rewards Platinum Elite for the primary cardmember; register at united.com/ihgstatus.

benefits.name: Avis President's Club
benefits.notes: Avis President's Club membership for the primary cardmember; enroll at united.com/AvisChaseBenefit.

benefits.name: United Club passes (All Access)
benefits.notes: 4 United Club one-time passes after each cardmember anniversary, only if you hold United Club All Access (Premier Gold or higher, or $50,000 in calendar-year purchases) and have an authorized user on the account.

benefits.name: DoorDash promo
benefits.notes: $10 off one non-restaurant DoorDash order while enrolled in DashPass via the card, through 12/31/2027. DoorDash lists every Chase co-brand (except Amazon, Instacart, DoorDash cards) as eligible with the promo "monthly or quarterly" by card; United's own card pages don't mention DashPass, so cadence is unconfirmed (quarterly assumed — monthly is likely if DashPass was first activated 9/1/2026 or later).
